Product Price and Merchant Information

Lio Mart may collect, receive, store, display, and process product information obtained from Merchants, Affiliate Partners, affiliate networks, APIs, feeds, or other authorized sources. Such information may include product name, product description, product image, price, discount, availability, seller information, and related product details.

The product price and related information displayed on Lio Mart may represent the information available from the relevant Merchant or Affiliate Partner at the time such information was received or last updated. Since Merchant prices and product information may change from time to time, the information displayed on Lio Mart may not always represent the Merchant’s current or real-time price.

Lio Mart may process such information for product listing, price comparison, affiliate tracking, cashback calculation, user experience, analytics, and related Platform operations. The collection or display of product price information does not constitute a guarantee by Lio Mart that such price will remain unchanged or will be available at the Merchant’s website or application at the time of purchase.
Users should verify the current price and other applicable charges directly on the respective Merchant’s website or application before completing a purchase.
